Zero Complex Gym Fluff.

No confusing jargon, no passive PDF routines, and no guesswork. Here is exactly what Fit Ninja puts in your pocket every day:

HD Video Form Guides

Never guess your form or feel intimidated by complex gym machines again. Clear 60fps looping video demonstrations show you proper technique for every exercise from the optimal angles.

Personalized Workout & Diet Plan

Get a 7-day workout split matched to your schedule, plus a tailored meal plan with exact calorie and protein targets (Veg, Non-Veg, Vegan, or Keto). Easily refresh or upgrade your plan whenever your routine changes.

Tailored to Your Body

Automatic "Lift Heavier" Progression

Building muscle requires lifting slightly heavier over time. Fit Ninja automatically remembers your previous weights and sets, telling you exactly when you're ready to add +1 kg to +2.5 kg so you never hit a plateau.

Continuous Muscle Growth

Distraction-Free Full-Screen Rest Timer

A clean, full-screen countdown between sets with audible chimes and vibration alerts. Built specifically to eliminate accidental mis-touches and stop you from doom-scrolling social media while resting.

Log what you eat in seconds. We give you realistic, approximate calorie and protein numbers for quick daily tracking, plus honest guidance on when to use a kitchen food scale for pinpoint accuracy.

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about Fit Ninja before starting.

How do I install Fit Ninja as an app on iPhone or Android? ▾
Fit Ninja runs as an ultra-fast Progressive Web App (PWA) with zero App Store download delay:
• iPhone (Safari): Open fit.socialninjas.in in Safari → tap the Share button (⎋) at the bottom → scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen" (⊞) → tap "Add".
• Android (Chrome): Open in Chrome → tap the three dots menu (⋮) at top-right → tap "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
Once added, Fit Ninja runs full-screen like a native app with offline caching and sound cues!
What makes Fit Ninja different from other gym workout apps? ▾
Most fitness apps are either glorified digital notebooks or complicated spreadsheets full of robotic jargon. Fit Ninja gives you 5,300+ looping animated video guides for every gym movement, automatic "Lift Heavier" recommendations based on your actual history, distraction-free full-screen rest timers, interactive front and back muscle recovery maps, and customized meal plans — all running 100% offline in gym basements.
Does the app work underground or without internet reception? ▾
Yes! Fit Ninja was built offline-first. All your exercises, logs, sets, and meals are saved securely on your phone. It runs flawlessly in gym basements with zero mobile network, and syncs automatically with our cloud backup whenever you're connected.
Why is the rest timer full-screen? ▾
We designed the full-screen rest timer to keep you focused between heavy sets. It gives you a clean countdown with clear sound alerts, prevents accidental mis-touches when setting your phone down, and stops you from mindlessly scrolling social media between reps.
How does food and calorie logging work? ▾
Food logging in Fit Ninja is fast and practical: search any food, enter your portion, and the app calculates your calories and protein immediately. These numbers give you a realistic daily approximation. If you want pinpoint accuracy for specific foods, using an inexpensive digital kitchen scale is always recommended!
Can I upgrade or customize my workout & diet plan later? ▾
Yes! Whenever your schedule changes, you plateau, or your goals shift (e.g. from fat loss to muscle gain), you can update your answers and generate a brand-new training split and diet plan in seconds. Your previous workout history remains safely stored.
How much does Fit Ninja cost? ▾
Right now, you can get the Fit Ninja Launch Pass for just ₹99 for your first month (less than ₹4/day). After month 1, your membership renews automatically at the standard rate of ₹399/month. You get complete, unrestricted access to all 5,300+ animated video exercises, guided workout player, full-screen rest timers, automatic weight suggestions, custom meal plans, and cloud backup. You can cancel anytime with 1 tap.
Why is there no free plan or ad-supported version? ▾
Free fitness apps survive by interrupting your rest timers with noisy 30-second video ads, collecting and selling your health data, or abruptly locking 90% of exercises behind paywalls when you reach the gym. Fit Ninja was built by athletes for athletes: 100% ad-free, 100% private, fully offline in basement gyms, and pro-grade from Day 1.
Can I cancel anytime? Are there hidden fees or commitments? ▾
Yes, you can cancel anytime with a single tap inside your Profile settings — no phone calls, no emails, no friction. There are zero hidden fees, and you retain full access until the end of your billing period.
